ideal: Every running task lives in a project, a waiting thread is two clicks from the sidebar, and a project idle for 30 days is archived. Search and pinned projects are shown in the app's sidebar (read there 2026-11-25) and the docs do not name them.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Let Claude coordinate ongoing work with Projects

quality: No cloud session carries project work outside its project.
speed: A waiting thread is within two clicks of the sidebar.
consumption: No idle project keeps a watching thread or scheduled task running.
